name: Timeless Island
source:
You play as a guy who just died. Fire elemental Imira offers you a deal to find her an amulet on Timeless Island in exchange for resurrection, you agreed.

Timeless Island is a place that exists outside the laws of time and space. People from different eras can get there. 

After getting to the island, you meet half-elf Fiona. She, gladiatrix Lina, and Bastet priestess Klio live there in the shelter, you decided to join them.

[From [url=https://ariohdaerthe.itch.io/timeless-island]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个刚刚死去的人。火元素伊米拉向你提出一项交易，让你在永恒岛上找到她的护身符，以换取复活，你同意了。

永恒岛是一个存在于时空法则之外的地方。不同时代的人都可以到达那里。

到达岛上后，你遇到了半精灵菲奥娜。她、角斗士莉娜和巴斯蒂特女祭司克里奥住在避难所里，你决定加入他们。

[来自[url=https://ariohdaerthe.itch.io/timeless-island]Itch.io[/url]]
